description: An attack and release envelope with a VCA, and a separate scaled copy of the envelope for modulating other modules

params.text: Sets the attack time, about 2ms at fully counter-clockwise to 8 seconds fully clockwise
Sets the release time, about 2ms at fully counter-clockwise to 8 seconds fully clockwise
Sets the level of the MOD output; the centre of its travel gives silence and the two ends give plus and minus one and a half times 5V

inputs.text: The signal the envelope is applied to
Starts the attack on each rising edge above 2V, reading low again below 0.1V

outputs.text: The envelope scaled by the MOD knob, reaching 7.5V at the top of the envelope with that knob fully clockwise and -7.5V fully counter-clockwise
The input multiplied by the envelope

notes: nothing comes out until a trigger arrives at TRIG; both stages are exponential and the attack is treated as finished once it has reached 95 per cent

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
high above 2V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
